text:
Our whole family gets our dental work done here. We've been impressed since our first visit. The service is excellent, the quality is great, and we love how clean the clinic is. We don't understand much about teeth, so we had a lot of questions. The doctor (Dr. Boss) patiently explained everything to us. He was very attentive to detail and gave great advice.
During the procedure, we felt the doctor was very gentle. We were very impressed with the results. Plus, we had a problem with tooth erosion, and after treatment here, our tooth sensitivity disappeared completely.

We've brought our 3-year-old son with us several times. All the doctors explain things well and in an easy-to-understand way. Most recently, our son saw Dr. Praewa, who has experience in caring for children's teeth. She's kind, patient, and the children aren't afraid. Originally, our son had deep pits and grooves in his teeth, and he had fissure sealants treated by her. The treatment was very good and helped slow down the progression of cavities.

There are many restaurants around the clinic, and it's easy to get there. Finding parking is always easy.
